engine: Saisei's render reveal — a NEW full-bleed render appears through a black centre SLICE that opens (centre->edges, power2.in: a hairline that dwells ~270ms then rips), and a dark VEIL over the render CLEARS IN SYNC with the slice, so the render brightens from dark to full colour exactly as the slice grows. The render is FIXED behind; the slice + veil do the reveal. Composes center-seam-split. Harvested from D_saisei (page-open render-slicer, t073-t080).

measured_teardown.move: the render sits full-bleed under a dark veil (opacity = veil); a center-seam-split cover OPENS over it (power2.in ~0.93s), exposing the render as a growing centre slice; the seam's live progress (onUpdate) drives the veil opacity veil->0, so the render surfaces dark->bright as the slice widens.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei /project open t073 (black slice, render barely visible) -> t076 (slice ~40%, render dim through it) -> t079 (slice ~92%, render wider, brightening) -> full.

veil.what: starting darkness of the veil over the render (how dim the render arrives).

fill.what: the slice cover colour (the black that parts to reveal the render).

ease.what: Saisei open curve: hairline dwells, then rips (NOT expo.out).

veilEase.what: the veil clears fully by this fraction of the slice (1 = lockstep; <1 = render brightens earlier than the slice finishes).

z.what: z-index of the injected slice cover over the stage.

entry: RenderSliceReveal.create(target, opts) -> { open(o), set(p), reset(), seam(), destroy }. target wraps .rsr-render (img) + .rsr-veil. open() runs the slice + synced veil-clear; set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of slice + veil; reset() re-covers + re-darkens. Composes center-seam-split (load its component.js first).
law: clip-path inset (the slice, via center-seam-split) + opacity (the veil) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the render; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant revealed. The veil is driven by the seam's onUpdate(progress) so it clears in exact sync with the slice. owns_pin false.
gate_mode: triggered (not scroll), the render is an behind a clip-path slice + veil — the wheel-scroll gate doesn't apply. Verify the slice curve (power2.in) and veil-sync directly.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO render — the black slice opens power2.in (t100=0.05%, t300=1.5%, t500=7.3%, t700=20%, t800=30%, t1000=50%) and the veil clears IN SYNC (0.8 -> 0.68 -> 0.47 -> 0.31 -> 0.10 -> 0) so the render brightens exactly as the slice grows. At slice 42% the render shows as a dim centre strip (matches Saisei t076). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 0/132 long frames (0.0%), 59.9fps.
